title: This Mammal Lives 18 Minutes Without Oxygen on Plant Fuel
subject: naked mole-rat

scenes.text: This mammal can survive 18 minutes with no oxygen at all. Humans can't come close.
It's the naked mole-rat, and it lives in crowded underground tunnels where the air gets thin.
Scientists cut its oxygen to zero. It passed out in about 30 seconds, but its heart kept beating for 18 minutes.
Its trick is a fuel swap. Most mammals burn glucose, and glucose needs oxygen.
The mole-rats switched to fructose, which doesn't. That chemistry had only been seen in plants.
When oxygen returned, they were breathing again within moments. A rodent running on plant chemistry.

description:
This mammal can survive 18 minutes with no oxygen at all.
Its trick: it switches from glucose to fructose, a plant-style fuel that doesn't need oxygen.
What would you want to learn from an animal like this?
